flaw: The first decision-dossier report stored an internal content digest in a field named as a file SHA-256, and interrupted-export recovery accepted a self-consistent rehashed bundle without recomputing it from the selected checkpoint and evaluation tensors.
cause: Artifact serialization integrity and numerical provenance replay were implemented as one internal bundle check rather than separate external-file and checkpoint/data replay checks.
repair: Report schema 4 stores the serialized-file SHA-256 and internal content digest separately.
The reader rejects symlinks, non-files, changed file hashes, wrong bindings, and changed source order.
Recovery and the CLI verifier recompute every dossier from the declared checkpoint and source-bound evaluation split on the declared device and require exact canonical equality.
Adversarial tests cover a wrong file digest and a rehashed changed contribution.

resource_refusal.guard: 512 MiB free-memory floor and no rising pageouts before Torch import
